name: Conservative known-source pre-raid
notes: Uncommon or rare, item level at most 65, with a recorded approved dungeon source or reviewed crafting source. A separately cited world-drop crossbow fills the ranged-weapon source-data gap.
No raid, reputation, PvP, vendor-only, unknown-source equipment, crafted epics or permanent enchants.
A common static role score selects gear; this is a controlled baseline, not an optimized pre-raid best-in-slot claim. Proc and set-bonus DPS are not scored.
Class, faction, profession, weapon specialization, hand configuration, unique and limit-category restrictions are respected.
Eligible rotation-enabling Wolfshead Helm and Manual Crowd Pummeler are preserved. Their lower item levels remain visible in the audit.
Race, talents, resolved rotation, consumables, buffs, encounter and seed are frozen from the reference experiment. Only equipment and swap equipment change.
All caster profiles share the reviewed Radiant Staff; their off-hand is empty. Other weapon families and hand layouts remain fixed to preserve weapon talents and rotation requirements.

Crafted trinkets and relics require the profile to hold the crafting profession, conservatively covering missing equip-skill flags. Slots without an approved legal option stay empty and are listed in the audit.

craftingNotes: Recipe allowlist excludes Bloodvine and Primal Batskin raid-material families, Alchemist Stone and unreviewed new tailoring/blacksmithing. Basic new Enchanting items use recorded craft sources and published beta recipe data; exact formula availability remains provisional. Reputation-learned tradeable recipes may be crafted by another player; direct reputation rewards are excluded.
